problemMessage.quoted: The key is wrapped in quotes. Remove them: env files and CI secrets keep quotes as part of the value.
problemMessage.bearer: The key starts with "Bearer ". Set only the key; the SDK adds the Bearer prefix.
problemMessage.assignment: The value includes a variable name (NAME=). Set only the key.
problemMessage.masked: This is the shortened key shown in the dashboard list, not the key. A key is shown in full only once, when it is created: create a new one at Settings > Keys and tokens.
problemMessage.whitespace: The key contains spaces or line breaks. Copy it again as one line.
